propositions: A ticket declaring no repository edits (file_impact_scope none) should keep its certified plan after an unrelated commit moves HEAD, without weakening conservative behavior for legacy or undeclared empty-impact tickets.
A signed scope classifier distinguishes three results: non-empty deps are 'paths', empty deps with own scope none are 'none', and any other empty dep set is 'unscoped'.
The authenticated manifest emits exactly one 'file-scope: none' line only for the none result, keeping paths and unscoped output byte-identical to the pre-feature contract.
A none declaration present only in unauthenticated plaintext cannot suppress stale-head; only the signed manifest declaration is honored.
Flipping scope between none and paths, or changing only no_file_impact_reason, yields stale-material via a distinct material fingerprint basis member.

The public resign_plan_review recovery path preserves none scope in its authenticated manifest, while legacy manifests without a file-scope line remain unscoped and fail closed to whole-HEAD freshness.
